actual: Add a read-only Nightly check item repo_hygiene_orphan_audit. It should scan the repository for suspicious orphan or legacy assets such as unreferenced code files, obsolete debug/backfill scripts, misplaced documents, temporary CSV/JSON/log/dump/checkpoint files, empty directories, duplicate/legacy remnants, and retired code. The Nightly job must generate tiered reports and candidate remediation lists, but must not delete files or mutate source/business state. Risk tiers must protect migrations, BUG JSON, standards, CI/nox/workflows, production config, registered MCP/tools/routers, and other dynamic entrypoints. Candidate cleanup must require human-reviewed PRs; only low-risk metadata/report generation is automated.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
